adminPasswordHint: Your current password is required for administrator privilege changes and account deletion.

confirmDeleteAccount: Delete {target}? Private cloud work and public shares will be removed. Reports and audit records stay private with the account identity removed. This cannot be undone.
error_LAST_ADMIN: Keep at least one verified active administrator before removing these rights.
reportPolicy: Reports require a verified account. A moderator reviews each report; sending one does not remove a project.
reportSent: Report received. Thank you for helping keep this place safe.
reportQueueHint: Inspect source to unpublish or block. Open user details to suspend an owner. Record the outcome here.
publicationPrivacyHint: Keep contact details, addresses and other personal details out of public titles and descriptions.
policyPlaceholder: Policy placeholder: the operator has not supplied a reviewed document. This page does not claim legal compliance.
dataPractices: Accounts store email, display name, language, password hash and security records. Cloud projects, their saved versions and previews are stored on the server. Public pages show display names, never account emails.
storagePractices: Necessary cookies keep sessions and protect forms. Browser storage keeps local projects, progress and preferences. Optional usage counts are off by default and need a separate choice when enabled. No advertising identifiers.
retentionPractices: Deletion removes public access and ordinary project source and history, and anonymizes the account. Reports and audit records may remain as private history; their text may contain personal information. Backup retention needs operator review.
agePolicyPending: Before public launch, the operator must decide age and guardian consent rules for the launch markets. An adult tester’s agreement is not automatically parental consent.
supportNotConfigured: The operator has not configured a support address yet.
exportDataHint: Download a private NDJSON file with your profile, projects and saved versions, previews and reports you submitted. Each line is JSON; keep the file safe.
selfDeleteHint: This closes your account, removes public sharing and erases ordinary project source and history. Reports and audit records stay as private history with your profile name removed. Export first if you want a copy.
localWorkAfterDelete: Your current project in this browser remains a local copy. Use New or Reset project to clear it.
confirmAccountEmail: Type your account email to confirm
selfDeleteConfirm: Close this account and erase ordinary cloud projects? This cannot be undone.
accountDeleted: Your account has been closed. Local browser work remains available.
closedTestAccount: Closed test: accounts are by invitation only. The editor, examples and local files work without an account.
closedTestOnly: Closed test: accounts are for invited adult testers only. Children can explore the guest editor with adult supervision, without registering.
testDataNotice: Creating an account stores your email, display name, password hash and account/security records. Cloud projects and their saved versions are stored on the server. You can export or delete your account in settings; reports and audit records may remain as private history. Browser work stays local until you choose cloud save. The Privacy page explains current practices; the legal policies are still unapproved drafts.
testContactNotice: For questions about the test or your data, contact the person who invited you. A public support address and final policies have not been approved yet.
testNoticeAcknowledge: I have read the closed-test data notice.
error_REGISTRATION_CLOSED: Public registration is closed. Use a valid invitation for your own email, or explore the editor without an account.
operationalDataNotice: We keep limited technical logs and error counts to operate the test. Browser error reports contain no code, messages, stacks or account identifiers. Protected backups have a limited retention period.
usageCountsNotice: Allow counts for this tab? We count runs, saves and sign-up steps, with no code, text, account IDs or email. A random tab identifier expires with the tab; live counts cover 30 days; protected backups may retain them longer. You can decline or stop at any time. Read the notice before choosing.
healthMetricDefinitions: Totals exclude deleted accounts and projects. Active means a new session, project revision or audited action in 7 days. Verified share describes current accounts, not a historical signup cohort.
analyticsSampleNote: Optional 30-day sample of consenting tabs. Event names are documented technical keys. The funnel requires stages in order in the same tab; other tabs/devices and non-consenting visitors are excluded. Counts are signals, not exact people or causal conversion.
analyticsDisabled: Optional analytics is disabled. No guest/run funnel is collected; current product totals above remain available.
previewCaptureHint: The current SCREEN frame will be published with this version. RUN the program first to choose a frame. Code and editor controls are not included in the image.
previewFromEditor: To replace the saved preview, open the program, RUN it and choose Update preview. Preview changes stay private until you publish again.
inviteRequestBody: This is an invited-adult closed test. Request a new one-time invitation for the configured administrator address. The link expires in seven days.
inviteRequestSent: If this closed test is available, a new invitation has been sent to the configured administrator address. Check that inbox and spam.
inviteUseEmail: Use the email address that received this invitation.
mail_invite_body: You have been invited to create the administrator account for the Randomize USR closed test. Use the email address that received this invitation. This one-time link expires in seven days.
